g.text: i shows what the highlighted entry runs and how risky it is · enter runs it (you confirm first) · a adds
your own. Details and results appear here.
Kratos can be manipulated by data it reads from this target -- a crafted log
entry, for example -- into proposing a harmful action. With this enabled, an
approved action runs directly through the sub-agent instead of only being
shown to you to run yourself.
The typed-EXECUTE approval gate stays required either way -- this only decides
what EXECUTE does once confirmed. Reversible any time from here.
↑↓ select · enter run · a add · m edit · space on/off · x delete · i details
c what the target allows · s re-sync · t telemetry · r roll back last run
e allow fixes on this target · d stop fixes · esc back
